name: A legacy wizard grinds through its steps
looks: A dated-looking import card holds a squiggly connector-line icon above a numbered checklist (upload, map columns, confirm, wait for review), two steps already marked done and a third spinning as pending, a thin progress bar reading "Step 3 of 7, 99%" beneath. A dry caption underneath notes how long this exact flow has existed.
build: Checklist rows are static except the spinning pending icon (continuous rotation) and the progress bar's fill, held just short of 100% the whole shot so it visibly never quite finishes. The caption fades in last, its one editorialising word in the accent colour.
sound: A slow, faintly tedious mechanical tick under the spinner, nothing else.
prompt: Show an old-fashioned multi-step import wizard, a couple of steps already done, one spinning as pending, a progress bar held just short of complete, with a dry caption underneath noting exactly how long this clunky flow has been unchanged.
